purpose: Import/export AI-code attribution without upgrading attribution into unsupported execution, safety, authority, or quality claims.

field_projection.note: Foreign UUID is an external identifier, not Bonfyre content identity.

field_projection.privacy: Do not dereference into prompts/tool output automatically.

field_projection.note: Provider/model identifier is attribution evidence; it is not proof the named provider served a particular turn.
Never treat a Murmur3 attribution hash as a Bonfyre BLAKE3/SHA-256 security identity.

field_projection.privacy: Vendor metadata must pass redaction/authority policy before EvidenceGraph promotion.

supported_by_agent_trace: which code ranges are attributed to human/AI/mixed/unknown contributors
which tool/model identifier was recorded for that contribution
which VCS revision and conversation reference the attribution belongs to
optional position-independent content hash supplied by the foreign trace

import_rules: Validate the foreign 0.1.0 schema before projection.
Bind all file/range attribution to the declared VCS revision; current working-tree line numbers are not equivalent.
Preserve foreign IDs and hashes with algorithm/type labels instead of recasting them as Bonfyre identities.
Conversation URLs remain references unless an authorized retrieval creates a separate evidence occurrence.
Do not infer provider fidelity from contributor.model_id; a model label is attribution metadata, not a provider receipt.
Do not infer an AgentSession merely because multiple ranges share one conversation URL; session continuity requires its own evidence.
export_rules: Export only attribution claims that can be supported at the requested VCS revision.
If Bonfyre has richer authority/effect/receipt evidence, keep it in a namespaced extension or linked evidence object; do not overload Agent Trace core fields.
Never export secrets, prompt bodies, tool outputs, private local paths, or authority grants through vendor metadata by default.
When a Bonfyre artifact has mixed human/agent lineage, preserve mixed attribution rather than selecting one actor for convenience.

composition.agent_trace_plus_bonfyre_receipt: Attribution says who/what produced a code range; ReceiptEnvelope says what governed execution/evidence was observed. They may reference the same ArtifactRef but remain separate claims.
composition.agent_trace_plus_trace_divergence: Attribution is a projection input for comparing two generated code lineages; it does not determine divergence severity.
composition.agent_trace_plus_aurekai: Aurekai may learn correlations between carrier/model attribution and verified outcomes only after joining through explicit evidence keys, never by treating attribution metadata as an outcome.

factor_validity_triggers: new standardized fields that overlap Bonfyre authority/evidence claims
